description.en: Material Theme for DSH Desktop: the official Material Theme palettes (32 schemes, 34 accent colours) and their syntax highlighting colours mapped onto the client theme tokens, with a settings row and a header switcher.
description.zh: DSH Desktop 的 Material Theme 主题插件：把官方 Material Theme 的 32 套调色板、34 个强调色与语法高亮色映射到客户端主题令牌，并提供设置行与会话顶部切换菜单。
